    cur=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return {i:tuple((j,c) for j,c in enumerate(cur[i][:60]) if c!='B') for i in range(28,46)}
def tippos(frame):
    for i in range(64):
        for j,c in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')[i]):

for (r,c,tag) in [(57,50,'N-left'),(57,43,'Y-right'),(57,35,'Y-left')]:

    print(tag,'changed',res['board_changed'],'rows',ch)
    for i in ch:
        if b[i]!=a[i]: print(' ',i,'B',b[i]); print(' ',i,'A',a[i])
    print('  tip',tippos(current_frame))
